statFormula.notes: Battle stats and balance are prototype values; the project documents have not approved an IV/EV/nature model or a final stat formula.

experienceYieldNote: These yields are prototype values for encounter testing, not a locked progression curve.
movePolicy: officialLearnset determines new creatures at their actual level; defaultMoveIds is a level-five preview. Prototype save compatibility is not required.
genderPolicy: Battle gender is selected deterministically from the official PokéAPI female ratio in eighths and the stable creature instance ID; genderless species remain genderless.
